entries.en: to drink; to drink wine
entries.notes: L 栏为截断形式「Bebex-」，R 栏对音与官话「饮」不合，义依 H「飲」与 M 栏定为「饮」。

entries.en: to drink at a banquet; to feast and drink
food and drink; to eat and drink

entries.zh: 食；吃（「食」兼指进食与饮酒）
entries.en: to eat; to consume food or drink
entries.notes: L 栏作「beber」，而 H「食」本义为「吃」；闽南语「食」兼用于饮酒，故两义并列。

entries.en: to drink in company; to keep someone company over drinks
entries.notes: L 栏「vna safari, y dar dos」残乱（疑为 una salud, y dar dos），H 栏[疑]陪/倍，据 M 栏与「en compañía」取「陪酒」。

entries.zh: 送下；以酒送饭（把食物送下肚）
entries.en: to wash down food with drink
entries.notes: H 栏[疑]送/迭，据 L「pasar la comida」取「送下」义。

entries.zh: 赏月；对月饮酒（中秋之俗）
entries.en: to drink in honor of the moon; moon-viewing with wine

entries.zh: 一口一口地喝；小口啜饮
entries.en: to drink sip by sip; to drink little by little
entries.notes: H 栏「獨口食」字面与 L「a tragos poco a poco」不尽合，R 栏对音亦乱，义取小口慢饮。

entries.en: fond of drink; a heavy drinker (lit. a slippery mouth)
entries.notes: R 栏与「口」对音不合，义依 H「口滑」及 L「beber demasiado, bebedor」。

entries.en: drunkard; heavy drinker
entries.notes: H 栏[疑]打/拍，M 栏声调非入声，字形与音读均未能定夺，仅存 L 义。

entries.en: drunkard; one infatuated with wine
a hard drinker who does not get drunk; great capacity for liquor
to wipe one's mouth after drinking
entries.notes: M 栏尾[残]，L 语序残乱，H「抹嘴」与「untar la boca」相合。

entries.en: bejuco; vine, rattan

entries.zh: 藤类；一种可制绳索的蔓藤（原字残）
entries.en: bejuco; a kind of vine used for cordage
entries.notes: H 栏原字残损（[疑:莉/葙]），仅能据 L「Bejuco」定为藤类。

entries.zh: 藤（某种可制绳的藤类，原字残）
entries.en: bejuco; a kind of rattan vine
entries.notes: H 栏首字残损，「藤」字明，据 L 定为藤类。

entries.en: rattan strip; cane (bejuco)
entries.notes: H 栏首字残损，「條」指藤条，据 L 定为藤类制条。

entries.en: wicked; evil-hearted; villainous
entries.notes: H 栏[疑]橫/壞，M 栏近「壞」、R 栏近「橫」，义从 L「bellaco y malo」。

entries.en: wild men; barbarians; mountain savages
entries.notes: 「野品」非通行词，依 L「bellacos, bárbaros, montaraz」取野蛮人之义。

entries.zh: 野马；粗野不驯（兼指愚妄）
entries.en: wild horse; an unruly fellow; (also) a fool
entries.notes: L 作「necio」，「野馬」本义为野马，取粗野不驯之引申。
